text:
Alex: New cluster in eu-west-3 is bootstrapped and passing infra smoke tests. Ready to hand off to on-call. Need paging config, ownership, and a short training run-through this week.
Maria: Awesome — thanks Alex. Quick checklist before handoff: node pool autoscale, GPU driver/firmware patch level, private subnet egress rules, monitoring alerts wired to PD, and cost tags applied.
Kevin: Paging note: we'll put GPU OOM and node unreachable to P1, evicted-daemonset to P2. I can draft PD rules today. @Liz can you confirm runbook links are up to date?
Liz: On it. I updated the bring-up runbook yesterday: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-west-3-cluster. Added a section for network egress troubleshooting and a small FAQ about quota errors.
Maria: PagerDuty snippet we should mirror (add to PD service -> escalation policy):
```yaml
service: eu-west-3-gpu
integration_key: <REDACTED>
escalation_policy:
  - step: 1
    targets: [sre-oncall]
    wait: 15m
  - step: 2
    targets: [sre-lead]
    wait: 20m
severity_mapping:
  - condition: "metric:gpu.memory.free < 0.1"
    severity: P1
  - condition: "kube.node.unreachable"
    severity: P1
  - condition: "kube.pod.evicted"
    severity: P2
```
Alex: Perfect. Also add a short-rate-limit alert for bursty model warmups to avoid a cascade of autoscale events.
Kevin: For ownership: proposal is SRE oncall owns pager for first 2 weeks post-launch, after that Platform rotates ownership to infra team for weekdays and SRE retains weekend oncall. Thoughts?
Maria: That split works. Let's make it explicit in the runbook and add contact matrix (primary, backup, triage).
Liz: Training: I'll run a 30m session Wed 10am CET covering the bring-up checklist, common GPU failures, and how to run these quick checks:
- kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu
- check gpu driver: nvidia-smi -L or `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv`
- pod logs for kubelet errors: `kubectl -n kube-system logs <kubelet-pod>`
Maria: Add these quickplay commands to the runbook with expected outputs and common remediation steps.
SRE-Bot: Incident template created: /incidents/templates/eu-west-3-gpu.json (autofill: cluster, nodepool, kernel, driver, recent deploys).
Alex: Good. Cost control item: tag all GPU nodes with team, project, and cost-center. Also enable nightly spot-eviction alerts to PD (P3) when spot reclaim rate > 5%/hour.
Kevin: I'll add the tagging policy to the cluster bootstrap script and include a post-deploy job that validates tags and sends a slack notification if missing. Example command: `kubectl get nodes -L team,project,cost-center`
Liz: Escalation path in runbook draft: oncall -> SRE lead -> Infra Eng manager -> Pager escalation to execs (only for sev-3 after 2 hours). Put contact numbers in vault not in plaintext.
Maria: Final step before handoff: a quick 15m dry-run paging drill tomorrow at 9am CET where oncall will ack an auto-trigger alert and follow the incident template. Can everyone make it?
Kevin: I'm in.
Alex: I'll be there to observe and answer questions.
Liz: I'll run the drill and capture gaps.
Maria: Assigning ownership tag in runbook: `owner: eng-sre/oncall`. Alex, please mark the cluster as "handoff-ready" in the infra dashboard when you've pushed the PD keys.
Alex: Done. Pushed PD integration key and set the flag in dashboard. Handoff ready. :white_check_mark:
Kevin: Thanks team. After drill, I'll finalize the PD escalation policy and add the weekend rotation schedule.
Liz: Uploading a short how-to video to the runbook page after the drill.
SRE-Bot: Scheduled drill reminder posted to #eng-oncall 1759234999.
Alex: Closing thread — will post the drill notes and final sign-off after tomorrow.
Maria: Thanks — great work. :rocket:
